note: Claude draft for Alexandria: OpenStreetMap has no wall lines here, so the Ptolemaic and medieval Arab walls are drafted whole; built-up area by period from the foundation (331 BCE) to 1900, the Pharos island and the Heptastadion with the sea on either side that has since silted into the Mansheya/Gomrok neck, Lake Mareotis and Lake Hadra before reclamation, the harbours, gates, the Canopic Way and the lost Ptolemaic and Roman monuments. The ancient street grid follows Mahmoud el-Falaki (1866-72); every shape is approximate (conf 2).
